description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 138. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 12
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (80 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
The user condenses a black ball in the hands and
then fires a beam from it.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 80 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 3d10 ki damage on a
fail, half on a success.
